title: Who Is He in Yonder Stall?

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Who is He in yonder stall,
At whose feet the shepherds fall?

sections.name: Refrain
lines: 'Tis the Lord, O wondrous story,
'Tis the Lord, the King of glory!
At His feet we humbly fall,
Crown Him, crown Him Lord of all.
At His feet we humbly fall- the Lord of all.
Crown Him, crown Him, Jesus, Jesus,
Crown Him Lord of all.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Who is He in deep distress,
Fasting in the wilderness?

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Who is He, the gathering throng
Greet with loud triumphant song?

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Lo, at midnight, who is He
Prays in dark Gethsemane?

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: Who is He on yonder tree
Dies in shame and agony?

sections.name: Verse 6
lines: Who is He that from the grave
Comes to heal and help and save?

sections.name: Verse 7
lines: Who is He that from His throne
Rules through all the world alone?
